expected_sections: Article 2 Qualification for Enrolment and Enrolment
Article 3 Representations and Warranties of the Vendor

claim_truth.subject: Tarion Warranty Corporation

object.value: administer the Ontario New Home Warranties Plan Act

claim_truth.evidence_quote: Tarion is a private, not-for-profit corporation designated by regulation to administer the Ontario New Home Warranties Plan Act.

claim_truth.subject: Vendor

object.value: licensed under the New Home Construction Licensing Act, 2017

claim_truth.evidence_quote: be licensed under the New Home Construction Licensing Act, 2017 ; and must ensure that any such homes are qualified to be enrolled

claim_truth.subject: Vendor

object.value: indemnify and save harmless Tarion from all costs, claims, damages, and liabilities

claim_truth.evidence_quote: costs, claims, damages and/or liabilities which arise resulting from or by virtue of:

claim_truth.subject: Vendor

object.value: notify Tarion promptly of any Material Change

claim_truth.evidence_quote: Material Change means a significant proposed, imminent, or implemented change in the business, operations, personnel, assets, liabilities or affairs of the Vendor

claim_truth.subject: Warranty Information Sheet and Addendum templates

object.value: be changed

claim_truth.evidence_quote: 3.9.3.6 The Warranty Information Sheet and Addendum templates be changed

claim_truth.subject: The agreement(s)

object.value: provide for the builder to complete the Home

claim_truth.evidence_quote: The agreement(s) shall provide for the builder to complete the Home

claim_truth.subject: the lender(s) providing construction financing

object.value: take priority over any such assignment by the Vendor

claim_truth.evidence_quote: the lender(s) providing construction financing shall take priority over any such assignment by the Vendor

claim_truth.subject: The Vendor
claim_truth.evidence_quote: interest at the rate of 1.5 per cent (1.5%) per month

claim_truth.subject: The Vendor

object.value: make the interest payment referenced in paragraph 3.8.1

claim_truth.evidence_quote: The Vendor shall make the interest payment referenced in paragraph 3.8.1

claim_truth.subject: Security

object.value: specifically confirm that the Security (and any proceeds thereof) is held by Tarion

claim_truth.evidence_quote: specifically confirm that the Security (and any proceeds thereof) is held by Tarion

claim_truth.subject: The source document

object.value: be in the forms supplied by Tarion without modification

claim_truth.evidence_quote: The source document shall be in the forms supplied by Tarion

claim_truth.subject: The Vendor

object.value: amend or alter the format, logos or language

claim_truth.evidence_quote: The Vendor shall not amend or alter the format, logos or language

claim_truth.subject: The Addendum

object.value: be attached to and forms part of the agreement of purchase and sale

claim_truth.evidence_quote: The Addendum shall be attached to and forms part of the agreement

claim_truth.subject: The Addendum

object.value: be split up and provisions shall not be deleted

claim_truth.evidence_quote: the Addendum shall not be split up and provisions shall not be deleted

claim_truth.subject: The Vendor

object.value: modify or amend the Addendum in any way

claim_truth.evidence_quote: The Vendor shall not modify or amend the Addendum in any way

claim_truth.subject: The Vendor

object.value: be responsible for any improper changes to the forms

claim_truth.evidence_quote: The Vendor shall be responsible for any improper changes to the forms

claim_truth.subject: The Warranty Information Sheet

object.value: be changed from time to time by government regulation

claim_truth.evidence_quote: The Warranty Information Sheet and Addendum may be changed from time to time

claim_truth.subject: Tarion

object.value: use best efforts to give notice of revisions

claim_truth.evidence_quote: Tarion shall use best efforts to give notice of revisions

claim_truth.subject: The Vendor

object.value: indemnify Tarion against any and all claims, losses, liabilities

claim_truth.evidence_quote: The Vendor agrees to indemnify and save harmless Tarion

claim_truth.subject: The Vendor

object.value: maintain comprehensive general liability insurance

claim_truth.evidence_quote: Vendor shall maintain comprehensive general liability insurance

claim_truth.subject: The Vendor

object.value: report to Tarion within ten days of any material change

claim_truth.evidence_quote: report to Tarion within ten days of any material change

claim_truth.subject: Tarion

object.value: inspect all books, records, and construction sites

claim_truth.evidence_quote: Tarion shall have the right to inspect all books and records

claim_truth.subject: The Vendor

object.value: hold all purchaser deposits in trust in accordance with legislation

claim_truth.evidence_quote: hold all purchaser deposits in trust in accordance with the Act

claim_truth.subject: Dispute Resolution

object.value: be resolved by arbitration pursuant to the Arbitration Act of Ontario

claim_truth.evidence_quote: Any dispute arising under this Agreement shall be referred to arbitration

claim_truth.subject: Governing Law

object.value: governed by the laws of the Province of Ontario and the laws of Canada

claim_truth.evidence_quote: This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of Ontario

claim_truth.subject: Default

object.value: Tarion may revoke enrolment or draw on security upon default

claim_truth.evidence_quote: Upon the occurrence of any Event of Default, Tarion may immediately revoke enrolment

claim_truth.subject: Termination
claim_truth.evidence_quote: either party may terminate upon thirty (30) days written notice

claim_truth.subject: Notice

object.value: be in writing and delivered by registered mail or email

claim_truth.evidence_quote: Any notice required to be given shall be in writing and delivered

claim_truth.subject: Confidentiality

object.value: keep confidential all proprietary vendor and warranty data

claim_truth.evidence_quote: Each party agrees to maintain the confidentiality of all non-public information

claim_truth.subject: Intellectual Property

object.value: all Tarion trademarks and standard forms remain the exclusive property of Tarion

claim_truth.evidence_quote: All trademarks, logos, and form templates are the exclusive intellectual property of Tarion

claim_truth.subject: Enrolment Fee

object.value: be paid prior to the confirmation of home enrolment

claim_truth.evidence_quote: The applicable enrolment fee must be paid prior to the confirmation of enrolment

claim_truth.subject: Survival

object.value: indemnity and security provisions survive termination of agreement

claim_truth.evidence_quote: The indemnity and security provisions contained herein shall survive the termination
